texts.value: Catalyzes the production of spermidine from putrescine and decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine (dcSAM). Has a strong preference for putrescine as substrate, and has very low activity towards 1,3-diaminopropane. Has extremely low activity towards spermidine
The activity is thought to be regulated mainly by the availability of decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine
kcat is 1.9 sec(-1) for aminopropyltransferase activity with putrescine as substrate (at pH 7.5 and 37 degrees Celsius) (PubMed:17585781). Inactive at 80 degrees Celsius (PubMed:17585781).
Amine and polyamine biosynthesis; spermidine biosynthesis; spermidine from putrescine: step 1/1
Belongs to the spermidine/spermine synthase family
